mapper.insert: insert into micro_ai_chat_message (session_id, tenant_code, role, content, route_json, evidence_json, clarify_json, intent, elapsed_ms, msg_time, created_by, created_date) values (#{sessionId}, #{tenantCode}, #{role}, #{content}, #{routeJson}, #{evidenceJson}, #{clarifyJson}, #{intent}, #{elapsedMs}, #{msgTime}, #{createdBy}, #{createdDate})
mapper.select: select intent from micro_ai_chat_message where session_id = #{sessionId} and role = 'ai' and intent is not null and intent != '' order by id desc limit 1
